cohort: 54 pregnant women with anterior placenta previa undergoing cesarean delivery, divided into two groups: 32 undergoing placental transection and 22 undergoing partial placental separation.
finding: Avoiding incision of the anterior placenta previa during cesarean delivery resulted in lower surgical blood loss and improved neonatal acidosis markers (pH, base excess, and blood lactic acid) compared to placental transection.
mod_finding: Avoiding incision of the anterior placenta previa during cesarean delivery resulted in lower surgical blood loss and improved neonatal acidosis markers (pH, base excess, and blood lactic acid) compared to placental transection.
